name: The Fisher King
desc: He is possibly the greatest fisherman who ever lived, in his own opinion anyway.

features.name: Whale Tale
features.desc: Mark a Stress to have The Fisher King begin to talk your ear off about some strange fantastical and probably untrue fish that he caught once upon a time long ago. A PC must succeed on a Presence roll to get him back on topic. On a fail they must listen to his whole story and Mark a Stress themselves.

features.name: Poles For Sale
features.desc:
Sells fishing poles and will teach a PC how to fish.

Fishing Pole: can be bought from him for 8 Handfulls.

Fishing Lesson: a single PC can be taught to fish for the Low Price of 2 Bags. After getting this lesson all fishing checks thereafter are made with Advantage.
features.flavor: Give a man a fish and he'll eat for a day, teach a man to fish and he will eat for a lifetime.
